compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I want conflict resolution policy implemented (local-wins on state, additive-merge on content, set-valued provenance), so that bidirectional updates converge to a deterministic result.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Conflict policy module. State fields: local-wins. Additive content: merge inbound. Set-valued fields: per-element provenance in bridge_state/mapping.json.

## Done Definitions
- Conflict policy produces deterministic merge result for every conflict class (state, additive-content, set-valued) given two divergent snapshots ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Set-valued fields persist per-element provenance in bridge_state/mapping.json[issue].field_provenance ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Test fixtures with simultaneous local/jira divergence resolve: state to local, description additively ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations
- [Risk] Set-valued provenance can grow unbounded; cap at 50 elements per field and emit bridge-alert when capped.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
